title.narrative: Enhancing food and nutrition security in the Southern Province of Rwanda.

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the action is to promote food and nutrition security and food systems resilience in Gisagara and Nyaruguru districts, which will be achieved through the following specific objectives/outcomes;

  1. OS 1: Increased adoption of sustainable food production practices for smallholder farmers Gisagara and Nyaruguru districts,
  2. OS2: Improved productivity and incomes for smallholder farmers including women-led and men-led SHGs (Self-Help Groups) and cooperatives,
  3. OS 3: Improved dietary intake among small-holder farmers.

The following outputs will contribute to the achievement of the above objectives;

  1. Output 1.1: Increased capacities of small holders on GAP (good agricultural practices) and sustainable agricultural management practices,
  2. Output 1.2: Strengthened capacity of the smallholder farmers on post-harvest management practices, value addition and post-harvesting technologies,
  3. Output 2.1: Increased availability of financial means and services for businesses (including women and/or youth led entities) active in innovative and sustainable agriculture,
  4. Output 2.2: Strengthened capacity of smallholder farmers from SHGs and cooperatives on business activities, enterprise development and investment skills,
  5. Output 3.1: Increased knowledge of smallholder farmers on nutrition-sensitive agriculture practices.
